title: Share of Pasteur's 1860 flasks of boiled yeast water that grew microbes after being opened in each place
description: Bar chart, percent of flasks spoiled, by our arithmetic from Pasteur's counts. Paris Observatory courtyard, 11 of 11 (100 percent); its cellars, 1 of 10 (10); countryside at the foot of the Jura, 8 of 20 (40); a mountain of the Jura at 850 meters, 5 of 20 (25); the Montanvert by the Mer de Glace at 2,000 meters, 1 of 20 (5). Data: Pasteur, Annales de chimie et de physique, 1862.
heading: FLASKS SPOILED AFTER OPENING · 1860 · %

source.container: Louis Pasteur, "Mémoire sur les corpuscules organisés qui existent dans l'atmosphère," Annales de chimie et de physique, 3rd series, vol. 64 (1862), pp. 83–86
